title: SqueezeNext: Hardware-Aware Neural Network Design
role: counterevidence to any broad claim that model compression ignored hardware metrics; not a frozen-frame sample
evidence_note: Uses neural-accelerator simulation to report inference speed and energy alongside accuracy/parameter counts. This is a relevant counterexample, though simulation/configuration-specific rather than a universal on-device measurement.

title: MultiTASC: A Multi-Tenancy-Aware Scheduler for Cascaded DNN Inference at the Consumer Edge
role: counterevidence and later deployment-oriented measurement; not a frozen-frame sample
evidence_note: Reports measurements on low-, mid-, and high-end smartphones and a T4 server, with latency/SLO and scheduler results. It addresses a later cascade/scheduling setting rather than directly re-evaluating ATQ or SMH.

title: Confidence-gated training for efficient early-exit neural networks
role: current counterevidence that early-exit mechanisms remain actively studied; not a frozen-frame sample
evidence_note: Proposes aligning training gradients with conditional early-exit inference and reports lower average inference cost with improved accuracy on Indian Pines and Fashion-MNIST. This counters an absence claim but does not directly test the sampled SDN under distribution shift or on diverse target hardware.

title: Can You Trust Your Model's Uncertainty? Evaluating Predictive Uncertainty Under Dataset Shift
role: construct counterevidence motivating confidence-threshold stress tests; not a frozen-frame sample
evidence_note: Benchmarks predictive uncertainty under dataset shift and finds post-hoc calibration and several existing methods can deteriorate, while some model-marginalizing methods remain stronger. This motivates but does not prove failure of any particular early-exit policy.
